dependency.structure: All nodes, every node label, all relationship occurrences, endpoints, directions and types.
dependency.property_rule: All fixed property names consumed by the 750 query texts, including a conservative superset of temporary-map field names; same whitelist applies to nodes and relationships.
dependency.access_forms: Fixed property access; fixed labels/relationship types; variable paths, entity equality, startNode/endNode and type consume preserved topology. Direct id(), elementId(), keys(), properties(), wildcard or dynamic named property consumption is checked. Original unbound value parameters remain unchanged and reproduce missing-parameter errors.

historical_graph_identity: unrecorded; this is a separately captured current graph view

consistency.isolation: Sequential read transactions with complete repeated content fingerprints and before/after counts; concurrent writes invalidate reuse when detected.

query_study.scope: Separately captured native input for the preserved Cypher query study; source and historical study outputs are related by subsequent exact per-query replay.
